# NAMMAL MEDIA - Malayaliyude Manasakshi

> "നമ്മള് - മലയാളിയുടെ മനസ്സാക്ഷി" (Nammal - The Conscience of the Malayalee)

## Brand Summary
NAMMAL MEDIA (nammalmedia.com) is a premier digital media platform and entertainment channel based in Trivandrum, Kerala, India. It produces and distributes high-impact Malayalam television shows, films, web series, cultural stage programs, interviews, and regional news.

## Key Program Highlights & Shows
- **Aswamedham**: The iconic reverse-quiz and intellectual television show hosted by G. S. Pradeep.
- **NAMMAL Originals & Shows**: Top Singer, Comedy Utsavam, Uppum Mulakum, Seetha, and original stage events.
- **Malayalam Cinema & Cultural Events**: Comprehensive cinema updates, star interviews, film distribution, and pay TV broadcasting.

## Business & Production Verticals
- Free to Air Television Production
- Film Production & Distributionz
- Web Series & Digital Media Network
- Infotainment & Stage Event Management
- Pay TV Broadcast Network
